messages:
nina: FYI I'm putting together a compact howto that covers: aptly-backed apt mirrors for air-gapped installs, containerd image import, and an example HSM access tunnel (ssh-based). Opening a PR shortly, want ops + security eyes.

alec: sounds good. can we prefer ssh tunnels over socat in the doc for ops that don't want extra tools? include sample autossh systemd unit; it's more robust.

rachel: +1 for autossh. also please include a short note about keeping the HSM management network on a separate VLAN and the implications for MTU and jumbo frames. we've seen packets drop when MTU mismatches.

 tom: quick apt mirror snippet idea (using aptly + nginx):
```
# create repo on mirror host
aptly repo create -component=main -distribution=bionic redwood-onprem
aptly repo add redwood-onprem /path/to/packages/*.deb
aptly publish repo -architectures=amd64 redwood-onprem:repo
# serve with nginx from /var/www/apt/repos
```

nina: nice. add brief instructions for signed repos (gpg key import + aptly publish -gpg-key). we should show verify steps on the client (apt-key or signed-by in sources.list).

alec: for the ssh tunnel (HSM proxy) here's an autossh unit you can use in the docs:
```
[Unit]
Description=autossh HSM tunnel
After=network.target

[Service]
User=redwoodops
Environment=AUTOSSH_GATETIME=0
ExecStart=/usr/bin/autossh -M 0 -N -L 4632:10.2.3.10:4632 redwood-hop.example.com -p 22
Restart=always
RestartSec=10

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
```

rachel: include validation curl and pkcs11-tool examples, e.g.:
`curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" http://127.0.0.1:4632/v1/status`
and
```
# list slots via pkcs11-tool
pkcs11-tool --module /usr/lib/softhsm/libsofthsm2.so -L
```

 tom: small nit: make sure we call out that pkcs11 libs differ by vendor; list SoftHSM path as an example but indicate customer HSM will have vendor path. Also call out that ssh tunnel exposes only TCP, so any UDP-based monitoring won't traverse.

nina: good catch. i'll add a short table of common vendor lib paths and a link to the vendor integration page.

alec: i'll review network and firewall snippets tonight. suggest a tiny nftables example to allow the local forwarded port only from loopback for extra safety: 
```
# allow forwarded local port only from loopback
nft add rule inet filter input iif lo tcp dport 4632 accept
```

rachel: i'll add a brief troubleshooting checklist (tcpdump, journalctl, autossh logs) in a follow-up PR. for now i'm ok with merging the howto once autossh unit includes User= and notes about key auth.

nina: thanks everyone 389 i'll resolve comments and merge once reviewers sign off. follow-up PR will expand on debugging and vendor-specific HSMs.
